rows.content: {"url": "https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/search?query=path+dependence+and+longitudinal+behavior+in+preference+formation+through+reinforcement+learning&format=json&resultType=core&pageSize=4", "scope": "Europe PMC search metadata, abstracts and full-text links; discovery only", "excerpt": "[{\"title\": \"Parenting styles and smartphone dependence among college students: the serial mediating roles of self-control and gratitude\", \"abstract\": null, \"doi\": null, \"pmid\": \"PMC13642792\", \"pmcid\": \"PMC13642792\", \"source\": \"PMC\", \"fullTextUrlList\": {\"fullTextUrl\": [{\"availability\": \"Free\", \"availabilityCode\": \"F\", \"documentStyle\": \"html\", \"site\": \"PubMedCentral\", \"url\": \"https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC13642792/?tool=EBI\"}, {\"availability\": \"Free\", \"availabilityCode\": \"F\", \"documentStyle\": \"pdf\", \"site\": \"PubMedCentral\", \"url\": \"https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC13642792/pdf/?tool=EBI\"}, {\"availability\": \"Free\", \"availabilityCode\": \"F\", \"documentStyle\": \"html\", \"site\": \"Europe_PMC\", \"url\": \"https://europepmc.org/articles/PMC13642792\"}, {\"availability\": \"Free\", \"availabilityCode\": \"F\", \"documentStyle\": \"pdf\", \"site\": \"Europe_PMC\", \"url\": \"https://europepmc.org/articles/PMC13642792?pdf=render\"}]}}, {\"title\": \"Dynamic Hippocampal-Striatal Information Flow Accompanies Behavioral Strategy Transitions During Sequential Learning in Pigeons: A Preliminary Study.\", \"abstract\": \"Sequential decision-making requires animals to flexibly balance model-based (MB) and model-free (MF) strategies to adapt to changing environments. The hippocampus (Hp) and striatum (ST) are two important components of the broader neural networks supporting these processes; however, how their dynamic interactions reorganize during learning-dependent strategy transitions remains poorly understood. Here, we trained pigeons on a two-step sequential decision-making task while simultaneously recording local field potentials (LFPs) from the Hp and ST. A dynamic reinforcement learning framework combined with a sliding-window approach was used to characterize temporal changes in behavioral strategies, and phase transfer entropy (PTE) was applied to estimate directed information flow between the Hp and ST across theta, beta, and broad gamma (30-80 Hz) frequency bands…
